Text: WHEN 24 hours have passed since the purchase, the loyalty service shall post the pending points to the member's balance.
Rationale: Return window before points become usable.

Text: WHEN 12 months have passed since points were posted, the loyalty service shall expire those points.
Rationale: Programme terms; Finance (SH-03 Grace Lim) requires 12 months to keep the points liability bounded.

Text: WHEN posted points are within TBD days of expiry, the loyalty service shall send the member an expiry reminder through the notification provider.
Rationale: Reminders reduce complaints about lost points (S-03).

Text: The loyalty service shall retain points transaction records for 7 years.
